description: This file contains classes and methods for training and using custom image classification models with deep learning frameworks, specifically supporting models like ResNet50, DenseNet121, InceptionV3, and MobileNetV2. It includes classes for training models and for classifying images using trained models, with functions for setting model types, loading models, and classifying images.

classes.name: ClassificationModelTrainer
classes.description: A class for training deep learning models for image classification using various supported architectures.

classes.name: CustomImageClassification
classes.description: A class for loading trained models and classifying images with support for multiple architectures.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for ClassificationModelTrainer, initializes internal variables.

methods.name: __set_training_param
methods.description: Sets training parameters based on the selected model type.

methods.name: __set_transfer_learning_mode
methods.description: Loads model weights and applies transfer learning mode settings.

methods.name: __load_data
methods.description: Loads training and testing datasets from specified directory.

methods.name: setDataDirectory
methods.description: Sets the directory containing training and test datasets.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsMobileNetV2
methods.description: Configures the trainer to use MobileNetV2 architecture.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsResNet50
methods.description: Configures the trainer to use ResNet50 architecture.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsInceptionV3
methods.description: Configures the trainer to use InceptionV3 architecture.

methods.name: setModelTypeAsDenseNet121
methods.description: Configures the trainer to use DenseNet121 architecture.

methods.name: freezeAllLayers
methods.description: Sets transfer learning mode to freeze all layers except the last.

methods.name: fineTuneAllLayers
methods.description: Sets transfer learning mode to fine-tune all layers.

methods.name: trainModel
methods.description: Trains the model with specified parameters, saving the best model based on validation accuracy.

methods.name: __load_image
methods.description: Loads and preprocesses an image from file path, numpy array, or PIL image.

methods.name: setModelPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the trained model weights file.

methods.name: setJsonPath
methods.description: Sets the path to the JSON file mapping class labels.

methods.name: loadModel
methods.description: Loads the model weights and prepares the model for classification.

methods.name: classifyImage
methods.description: Classifies an input image and returns the top predicted labels and probabilities.
